articles.title: Advanced weapon systems, BrahMos missiles on display at 78th Army Day Parade in Jaipur
articles.summary: The 78th Army Day Parade in Jaipur showcased India's formidable military capabilities, featuring advanced weapon systems, armoured vehicles, and the powerful BrahMos missiles. Held on Mahal Road in the presence of the Army Chief, the event celebrated the Indian Army's valor and preparedness. For SSB aspirants, this highlights India's commitment to modernizing its forces and safeguarding national security, offering insight into our defence prowess and military hardware.

articles.title: Is it safe to swim with a sperm whale?
articles.summary: The article explores the complex question of swimming with sperm whales, highlighting that while awe-inspiring, it carries significant inherent risks. Such encounters are not straightforwardly safe and typically demand extensive experience. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the importance of thoroughly assessing risks and understanding environmental complexities before engaging in potentially hazardous activities, even those that seem fascinating.
